regime_read.macro: April-May was a bullish pump on the ceasefire plus strong earnings (NVDA named). Coming into late June he is trend-following, not fading.
regime_read.trader_words: It was just a given that we were gonna keep going up. Being conscious of what's happening in the big businesses around the NASDAQ is really important.

pre_session.asia: Opened up, sold off, has been trending up since.
pre_session.structure: Already swept the previous day's high. Thursday 18 June stalled at this level and it has not been broken coming into the London open.
pre_session.location: Trading heavy into VWAP +2; at the very top of the weekly range on the anchored volume profile - 'topping out this range'.
pre_session.bias: Not inclined to longs unless a rebalance to the 15m or 1h presents. More inclined to shorts.

outcome.note: R unrecoverable - stop never stated. Excluded from aggregates.

decisions.reason: Nothing pieced together. Disliked the 07:00 NY rally that dumped straight back after a big 15m wick through the 15m Bollinger band. Still stalling at the top of the range.
decisions.note: Whole-window pass, not a specific candidate.

decisions.reason: Developing daily value area high sitting right there, and price has stalled around the value area highs all day - it wicked around them at market open before pumping back up. Also the 07:45 15m was a good rejection candle, so it could keep going up. 'I'd be okay with taking shorts with some extra confirmation here.'
decisions.classification: Valid trigger, correct direction for the standing bias, PASSED for want of extra confirmation at a level he rated as strong.
decisions.value: This is the boundary row - a mechanically valid short in his own bias, declined.

trigger.setup: Rejection off the developing daily value area high, then closure back through VWAP+1 and the 2m BB MA.

stop.rationale: Bottom of the candle BODY, not the wick - 'I don't like how big the stop is.' Body bottom 30822.50, so ~4.5pt of clearance beyond it.

his_own_critique.text: It would have been better if I entered on the retest. Since we're actually making agents do this shit, we should start entering on the retest, because that's more so how I actually fucking trade.
his_own_critique.verified: 30851 would have filled ~09:54 (lows 30843.75 / 30842.50). Same 30818 stop = 33pt risk; same 30928 target = 77pt. That is 2.33R against the 1.0R he actually took. His 'easy 2:1' is arithmetically correct.

trigger.trader_words: For my trade to invalidate, it has to break through this 3-minute Bollinger Band and VWAP +1, and that's a double anchor right there.

entry.placement_habit: I usually like to give it a couple points from where it actually is.

stop.rationale: Just above the displacement candle high (30911.75) - the level that invalidates the double anchor.

decisions.thesis: Stalling heavily around all-time highs; expecting a sell-off, or at minimum a rebalance to the 15m BB MA.
decisions.target_selection_reasoning: Weekly value area high was ~30759 and the VWAP mid was ~30743 - only 15 points apart. 'Price never touches a value area high and then just runs straight from it. It usually wicks around, and with VWAP right there, I'm inclined to believe it would touch VWAP.' So he took the further of two clustered levels.

outcome.OPEN_QUESTION: 0.75 x 2.68R + 0.25 x 3.80R = 2.96R blended; the runner leg alone is 3.80R. Which convention gives 3.6?

decisions.aftermath: Price ran to 30540 by 12:00 NY - the untruncated move was far larger. Recorded as fact, not as criticism of the exit.

declared_changes.change: ENTRY GRAMMAR: limit orders on the retest, not market on the trigger close.
declared_changes.quote: If we're teaching an agent to trade a trade like me, we're going to start taking fucking limit orders.
declared_changes.evidence_same_day: N1 market 1.0R vs retest-limit 2.33R on identical stop and target.
consequences: R algebra changes: better fill, tighter stop, same structural target.
NEW FAILURE MODE: no retest means no fill means no trade. Needs a declared rule for how long the limit rests and whether it is ever chased.
The trigger candle stops being the entry bar and becomes the SIGNAL bar; the retest level (the BB MA it displaced through) becomes the entry price.

declared_changes.change: He will start narrating PASSES that were objectively valid entries.
declared_changes.quote: There were definitely some that were objectively valid entries, but at the same time, because of my discretion, I didn't take them.

declared_changes.change: Add a macro/events agent to the stack.
declared_changes.detail: Reads recent events affecting the NASDAQ and the big constituents (earnings named explicitly). Must be biased toward ACTING - explicitly not an agent that gets too scared to take trades.
declared_changes.quote: I don't want an agent that's gonna be too worried about things... I think it's important that the agent is acting.
